name: Sesame Street
hook: The 1969 public-TV experiment that taught counting, cookies and grouches to generations.

facts.statement: Sesame Street premiered in 1969 on public television, produced by the Children's Television Workshop, co-founded by Joan Ganz Cooney.

facts.label: Big Bird
facts.statement: Big Bird is the giant yellow bird; Caroll Spinney was the original puppeteer for both Big Bird and Oscar the Grouch.

facts.label: Oscar the Grouch
facts.statement: Oscar the Grouch is the ill-tempered Muppet who lives in a garbage can.

facts.label: Cookie Monster
facts.statement: Cookie Monster is the blue Muppet whose catchphrase is "Me want cookies."

facts.label: Elmo
facts.statement: Elmo is the red Muppet whose Tickle Me Elmo toy became the hottest holiday item of 1996.

facts.label: Bert and Ernie
facts.statement: Bert and Ernie are the odd-couple roommates who have shared an apartment since 1969, named after characters in It's a Wonderful Life; Ernie sings "Rubber Duckie."

facts.label: The Count
facts.statement: The Count is the vampire-style Muppet who loves counting; he played a census taker in a 2020 public service announcement.
